params.name: receiveVar
params.description: Variable receiving whatever characters are currently in the serial buffer; empty if the buffer is empty.

overloads.semanticRole: Immediately drains and clears whatever characters are currently sitting in the serial port buffer (opened via SET CHANNEL) into receiveVar, without waiting for a stop character or byte count.

constraints: Differs from RECEIVE PACKET: RECEIVE BUFFER takes whatever is currently in the buffer and returns immediately, while RECEIVE PACKET waits until a stop character is found or a requested number of bytes has accumulated.

On Windows the serial buffer is capped at 10 KB; on both Windows and macOS, once full, new incoming characters overwrite the oldest buffered characters, so the buffer must be drained promptly to avoid data loss.
The read interrupts on Ctrl-Alt-Shift (Windows) / Command-Option-Shift (macOS), raising error -9994, catchable via an ON ERR CALL method.
